ja: ドアは鍵がかかっている。

key: I tried to grab a balloon I saw floating down the street, but it turned out that it was that Pokémon!
en: I tried to grab a balloon I saw floating down the street, but it turned out that it was that Pokémon!
ja: 通りに風船が浮いてるのが見えて捕まえようとしたら、あのポケモンだったんだ!

key: It carried me all the way up here...
en: It carried me all the way up here...
ja: そのままここまで運ばれてきちゃって……

key: But how can I get back home with that thing right there?
en: But how can I get back home with that thing right there?
ja: でも、あいつがあそこにいたら、どうやって家に帰ればいいの?
え? フワンテを倒したの?!

key: That means it's safe to leave, right?
en: That means it's safe to leave, right?
ja: じゃあ、もう出ても大丈夫ってこと?

key: Okay! I think I can make it home!
en: Okay! I think I can make it home!
ja: よし! これなら家に帰れそう!

key: I live in the Lapis Ward, so...
en: I live in the Lapis Ward, so...
ja: ぼく、ラピスワードに住んでるから……

key: You're really cool and you should come visit sometime!
en: You're really cool and you should come visit sometime!
ja: ほんとにかっこいいから、いつか遊びに来てよ!
うん、ありがとう! じゃあね!
